biography:
Accomplished Real Estate Development, Design, Construction and Planning Professional with broad-based
experience leading the master planning and development strategies for major Industrial, Retail and Mixed-Use Real Estate. Expertise in building and executing strategies that improve brand visibility and geographic presence while meeting operating goals. A demonstrated record of successfully producing consistent results for industry leading global companies that have included Bridge Investment Group, Brookfield Properties Retail, Rouse Properties and Toys R Us.
